headline: Seven niches get their first scores; archival restoration debuts at 90
paragraphs: Biggest score moves since yesterday: disasters 80 to 83, robotics-humanoids 83 to 85 (17 to 33 channels). First scores: archival-restoration 90, retirement-planning 88, ev-green-tech 87, hands-only-cooking 86, travel-guides 85, coding-tutorials 78, hands-only-crafts 48 (lowest breakout rate, 29%).

Top breakout is still TALEYE's Florida Learjet 60 video in aviation: 17,517.5x its channel's typical views (4,414,405 views, 3,750 subscribers). New in archival-restoration: Colorized Images' Franz Reichelt film, 1,215.2x (409,506 views). Lofi multiples up to 61,249x are provisional.

Added three niches to track: hyper-casual-mobile-gameplay, guided-prayers and drone-light-shows, from OutlierKit's June 2026 untapped-niches list, not this week's data. Thumbnails did not load, so 9 channel entries (8 verdicts, 1 non-English flag), no thumbnail tags and titles-only niche notes.
